name: Clonidine (imidazoline-I1 / alpha2)
notes: Drug. Nisch is 100% detected and FALLS with maturation; Adra2a/b/c are absent from the store so the alpha2 arm is unmeasurable here.

name: beta-adrenergic tone
notes: Liu 2019 Sci Transl Med: beta-AR controls CM cytokinesis. Adrb1 RISES with maturation.

name: Nrg1 / ErbB2
notes: Erbb2 is P0-enriched (Baniol Fig 6).

name: IGF axis
notes: The P0-enriched Igf2/H19 locus. Igf1 itself is largely non-myocyte here.

name: mechanical load
notes: The in-vivo vs in-vitro discriminator on mitotic entry.

name: environmental oxidative stress
notes: Puente 2014 Cell: the oxygen-rich postnatal environment.

name: developmental stage
notes: hiPSC 0.12 / P0 0.30 / P7 0.55 / P15 0.75 / adult 0.95. Composite anchor: FAO up, Amotl1 down, Tubb2b->Tuba4a.

name: culture flag
notes: 21% O2 and no load. Required to get one drug and three outcomes.

name: cAMP
notes: Second messenger; convergence hub for Clonidine (down) and BetaAR (up).

name: PKA
notes: Activity is cAMP-dependent rather than transcriptional.

name: ERK1/2
notes: Mitogenic arm; phospho-regulated.

name: PI3K / Akt
notes: Merged to hold the depth budget.

name: autophagy
notes: Murganti screened 94 autophagy compounds; clonidine's proposed mechanism.

name: p38 (gamma)
notes: t=+4.49 on the maturation axis. Mapk14 (p38-alpha) goes the OTHER way (t=-1.28) - do not use it.

name: YAP / TAZ
notes: Localization-controlled; Yap1 mRNA is flat. Qualitative only.

name: Amotl1
notes: t=-6.56 - the largest single-gene maturation anchor in the panel.

name: reactive oxygen species
notes: Integrator: environment OR culture OR fatty-acid oxidation OR unloaded.

name: DNA-damage response
notes: HYPOTHESIS-ONLY. All four genes are FLAT on the maturation axis (t = +0.41/+0.64/-0.14/-0.91); the evidence is Puente 2014 rather than this dataset.

name: cyclin G1
notes: t=+1.85, and noncycling > cycling in 4/4 group pairs. G2/M arrest, linked to CM polyploidy.

name: p21 (Cdkn1a)
notes: t=+1.55; not in the phase-calling lists.

name: fatty-acid oxidation
notes: The four largest effects in the whole panel (t = +5 to +11). P7-high.

name: cyclin D / Cdk4-6
notes: Ccnd1 is dropped - 0-25% detection. Ccnd2 is in ~100% of cells.

name: Rb (hypophosphorylated)
notes: TRAP: Rb1 mRNA is 2.8x UP in cycling cells because it is itself an E2F target, while Rb ACTIVITY must be down. Never score naively.

name: E2F1
notes: Activator. Cycling-restricted; flat on maturation.

name: E2F2
notes: t=+2.18 - the only E2F activator that RISES with maturation in cycling cells. The endoreplication candidate.

name: E2F3
notes: t=-0.07 - a free pre-registered NEGATIVE CONTROL. The model must not move it.

name: E2F6
notes: t=+4.12; the only member expressed in noncycling cells (100% of noncycling P7 vCM). Exit enforcer. Slow tau: the delay is the mechanism.

name: E2F7
notes: t=-0.20 - FLAT on maturation. Must be a separate node from E2F8.

name: E2F8
notes: t=+2.28. In the S-phase gene list, so circular on the cycling axis but clean on the maturation axis.

name: E2F repressor pool
notes: Integrator: OR-pool over E2F6/7/8. Semantics - any repressor suffices.

name: E2F activity
notes: Integrator: activators AND NOT repressors. Closes the delayed negative-feedback loop and holds the depth budget.

name: cyclin E / Cdk2
notes: Both RISE with maturation in cycling cells (t = +2.23 / +2.39) - the G1/S delay Baniol describes at P7.

name: p27 (Cdkn1b)
notes: t=-1.67 - predicted mild decrease.

name: S-phase entry
notes: The PREVALENCE node - the only one that carries how many cells cycle. Calibration target 0.0992 at the hiPSC context.

name: cyclin A / Cdk2
notes: t=-0.85 (flat) - a clean comparator for Ect2 and not in the phase lists.

name: cyclin B / Cdk1
notes: Ccnb1 t=-2.12; Ccnb1 is not in the phase lists.

name: Myt1
notes: t=+2.81 - the mitotic brake that actually rises. Wee1 goes the other way (t=-1.32).

name: Cdc25 phosphatases
notes: Opposes Pkmyt1. Cdc25b 0.90 -> 0.61.

name: mitotic competence (raw)
notes: Brakes only - deliberately NOT gated on SPhase. Competence is conditional on entry; prevalence lives in SPhase alone.

name: mitotic entry / NEB
notes: Sharpening gate. If this never fires: G2 arrest, no envelope breakdown, nuclear polyploidization. Target 0.7698 at hiPSC.

name: Cdc20 / APC-C
notes: Fzr1 is the APC/C co-activator; Cdh1 in the gene list is E-CADHERIN (4->0% detected). Murganti: polyploid cells show no APC activation.

name: Ect2 (RhoGEF)
notes: t=-6.17, 3rd percentile genome-wide. THE maturational lesion, and a known E2F7/8 repression target (Pandit 2012).

name: RhoA
notes: t=-3.82 but the 29th percentile genome-wide - significant, NOT specific. Included as Ect2's substrate, not as an independent finding.

name: centralspindlin
notes: Comparator: essentially flat (t = -1.73 / -1.49). Driven by E2F activity only - no maturation term.

name: Aurora B / borealin
notes: Comparator: t=+1.17 (up if anything). Murganti's midbody readout.

name: anillin
notes: Comparator: flat (t=-1.48).

name: midbody / Cep55
notes: ESCRT recruitment for abscission.

name: abscission competence (raw)
notes: Competence gate input.

name: abscission
notes: Sharpening gate. Mitosis WITHOUT this = binucleation. Target 0.5028 at hiPSC.

name: Ki-67
notes: 2.28 in cycling vs 0.02 in noncycling. An explicit instantaneous-prevalence output, kept distinct from the cumulative fate fractions.

name: quiescent / exited
notes: Fate 1.

name: productive division
notes: Fate 2. tau from the measured 16.38 h S/G2/M (0.693*tau); a definition, not a prediction.

name: binucleation
notes: Fate 3. tau from 17.29 h.

name: nuclear polyploidization
notes: Fate 4. tau from 24.50 h - the significantly longer one.
